Maria (Support): Heads up — customer reported a refund/chargeback that appears to have clawed their free-trial credits and pushed their account to -$12. API calls are now getting 402s. Need billing + eng to triage. Details in thread.

Anna (Customer): Hey, our app started failing right after a refund showed on our card. We lost the trial credits and now calls return 'insufficient funds'. Ticket #12345. Please restore if possible.

Maria (Support): Repro steps I ran: use their api key, call /v1/generate -> response 402. Then call our internal billing lookup for customer_id cust_7721: returns {"balance_cents": -1200, "promo_credits": 0, "grants": [ {"id": "g_891", "amount": 5000, "status": "revoked"} ] }. They had 5000 trial units yesterday.

Jordan (SE): Can you paste the exact API error and the ledger entries you see? Was this triggered by a Stripe refund webhook or a manual refund in the console?

Maria (Support): API error snippet: ```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "insufficient credits",
    "code": 402
  }
}
```
Ledger tail (redacted): ```
2026-11-02T14:02:11Z payment_refund id=r_443 amount_cents=1200 source=stripe_refund
2026-11-02T14:02:12Z promo_clawback id=cb_77 grant_id=g_891 amount_cents=5000 reason=refund
2026-11-02T14:02:12Z balance_adjust id=a_900 new_balance_cents=-1200
```

Kevin (Billing): I pulled the same ledger. We have an automated clawback job that runs on refund events. It is supposed to only clawback applied promotional credits, not system free-trial grants. Two possibilities: the grant was created without a grant_type so the job treated it as promo, or the webhook payload set refund_kind=chargeback and matched a too-broad rule. I'm checking the clawback rule logs now.

Chris (Finance): I see the reversal event referencing promo_id=trial-2026-11. The grant_type field is null in the ledger row which is suspicious. That could be the source of the misclassification. Opening a finance reconciliation ticket.

Sophie (Eng): Assigning this to me. Hypothesis: the clawback service filters on refund_event.present and not on grant_origin. If a grant has grant_origin=null it falls into the promo path. Quick guard: require grant_origin=="promo" before clawback. I'll validate on staging.

Jordan (SE): For immediate customer relief, can we grant manual credits and mark them as non-clawback so if Stripe reverses dispute we don't double-correct? Also need to ensure we don't create bookkeeping headaches for finance.

Sophie (Eng): Workaround plan: write a manual ledger entry `manual_credit` for cust_7721 with amount_cents=5000 and metadata {"no_clawback":true, "support_ticket":12345}. I can also add a temporary feature flag to disable auto-clawback for that customer while we investigate. Hotfix target: 30m.

Kevin (Billing): Finance prefers we avoid toggling global behavior. Manual credit + a reconciliation ticket is safest. If this was a chargeback/dispute, Stripe can re-open the dispute which may require reversing the manual credit later — finance will want an audit trail. I'll prepare FIN-2026-333 for reconciliation.

Chris (Finance): FIN-2026-333 created and linked to ledger extract. Please ensure any manual credits include `source=support_manual` and `recon_id=FIN-2026-333`.

StripeBot: Webhook event received: charge.dispute.created ch_1Gk4zX... amount=1200 customer=cust_7721

Maria (Support): Thanks. I'll message Anna letting her know we're issuing a temporary restore and that finance will reconcile. ETA?

Sophie (Eng): Deploying patch to staging now, will push feature-flag toggle to prod in ~30m if tests pass. I'll add the `grant_origin` guard and a safeguard to not clawback grants tagged `system:trial`.

Kevin (Billing): Once manual credit done, I'll block the clawback job on that specific ledger id to prevent double-clawing.

Jordan (SE): I'll prepare the support reply: short note, credited 5000 trial units temporarily, we will follow up post-reconciliation.

Maria (Support): Please paste the manual credit audit ID here once created and I'll update ticket #12345 and ping the customer. :thumbsup:

Sophie (Eng): Manual credit created ledger id a_manual_2145, amount_cents=5000, metadata includes no_clawback and recon_id=FIN-2026-333. Patch merged to main, deploying prod toggle now.

Kevin (Billing): Reconciliation and follow-up assigned to me + Chris. We'll close FIN-2026-333 after ledger confirmation.

Maria (Support): Great work everyone. Keeping thread for the postmortem — we should add a test for grant_origin null handling and add an alert if clawback affects `system:trial` grants.

Jordan (SE): Noted. I'll add an integration test to the billing test suite and a regression eval.

Maria (Support): I'll update the customer: "We've temporarily restored your trial credits (audit id a_manual_2145). We're investigating the refund/clawback interaction and will confirm when reconciliation is complete. Apologies for the disruption."

Chris (Finance): Closing loop: FIN-2026-333 will include a decision matrix for when manual credits can be issued and how to record them.

Maria (Support): Thanks team. If anything else pops up please ping here.
